verdicts.reason: A drops the product: the can is gone except a stray orange sliver poking out under the subhead. Its big CTA crowds the right edge over a leftover circle fragment, and the glow panel is an empty smudge. B keeps a recognisable (though tiny) can in its image panel. But its headline wraps to leave 'nights' orphaned, the CTA also sits on a clipped circle at the right edge, and the logo is very small, so B is only the less broken of the two.
